pages.text: An oak tree stood along the path behind the kindergarten. Many acorns had fallen beneath it.
Duri opened a bag wide and dropped in an acorn. Duri would fill the bag with acorns.
Without closing the bag, Duri ran off. Bigger acorns lay over there.
Duri bounced this way and that. The bag swung on their back.
Duri added another handful of acorns. The bag was still wide open.
Time to return. The children put on their bags and lined up.
Duri peered into an empty bag. "Where did they go?" Acorns dotted the path behind.
Teacher Bau picked up an acorn, put it in the bag, and zipped it shut.
Duri retraced the path, closing the zipper after each acorn went in.
The bag bulged. Duri poured the acorns into the classroom box.
